newsitem.title: UK: Phytopharm signs JV with Indonesia firm.
newsitem.headline: Phytopharm signs JV with Indonesia firm.

text.p: British medicine firm Phytopharm Plc said on Thursday that it had signed an agreement with Phytochemindo of Indonesia to develop a medicine to treat osteoarthritis and inflammatory bowel conditions.
The global market for anti-inflammatory durgs is currently worth over $6.0 billion.
Phytopharm said it would control 51 percent in the joint venture with the balance held by the Phytochemindo.
The product will be lincensed to Phytopharm which will retain the rights to distribute and market the product globally, excluding Indonesia.
Phytopharm and Phytochemindo will share downstream revenues from onward licensing agreements.
The product entering joint development is based on a plant extract which has been used as an anti-inflammatory in Ayurvedic medicine for many years.
The company said animal and Phase II clinical studies have shown that the extract, patented in Europe, USA, and Japan was effective and well-tolerated.

"This agreement should be seen as the first in a series which will give Phytopharm the global rights to patented products, under conditions which enable us strictly to control manufacture and plant horticulture," Ian Rubin, Phytopharm's chief operating officer said.
Phytopharm rose 11 pence to 143-1/2 after the announcement of the joint venture.
